definitions.explanation: A person who is truthful and sincere. Can be used positively (praising honesty) or with a nuance of being naive or too trusting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正直者|しょうじきもの}だ。
{正直者|しょうじきもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{世|よ}の{中|なか}→世の中：03666_yononaka⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a world where honest people end up getting the short end of the stick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正直者|しょうじきもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{幸|しあわ}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In folk tales, the honest person finds happiness in the end.

notes:
USAGE:
The expression {正直者|しょうじきもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (honest people get the short end of the stick) is a well-known proverb expressing the idea that being too honest can be disadvantageous. In Japanese folk tales (⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧), the honest character is typically rewarded while the dishonest one is punished.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正直者|しょうじきもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (honesty doesn't pay)
- {正直者|しょうじきもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{得|とく}をする→得をする：30190_tokuwosuru⟧ (honesty pays off)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誠実|せいじつ}→誠実：14211_seijitsu⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: sincere person — more formal
- ⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: straightforward, obedient person — emphasizes being receptive and unresisting
